hero.title: We are
hero.description: We are passionate about contributing to and improving the world we live in. <highlight>We care for your health and the planet.</highlight>

whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.description: At Nouvie SAS we are dedicated to caring for the health of people and the planet through products that are <highlight>free of toxic chemicals, biodegradable and sustainable</highlight>. Our mission is to offer cleaning and personal care solutions that protect those who use them and reduce environmental impact.
whoWeAre.quote: At Nouvie, we believe quality should never compromise health. That is why we educate and accompany our clients on the path toward more conscious and responsible consumption.
whoWeAre.line1Description: Free of sulfates, parabens and animal cruelty, designed for the well-being of the scalp.
whoWeAre.line2Description: Safe formulas for the whole family, without toxic or corrosive ingredients.
whoWeAre.line3Description: Certified products, phosphate-free, that optimize water and time, ideal for operators.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.paragraph1: At Nouvie, we commit to protecting the health of people and the well-being of the planet by developing cleaning products and hair treatments <highlight>free of toxic chemicals, corrosives, sulfates, parabens and flammable substances</highlight>. Our philosophy is based on the belief that quality should never compromise well-being.
mission.paragraph2: We produce biodegradable formulas, free of phosphates and animal cruelty, that respect both the human body and the natural environment. We believe in the power of awareness: that is why we educate our clients about the risks associated with conventional products containing harmful ingredients, and inspire them to make more responsible decisions.
mission.paragraph3: Our commitment to sustainability is constant. We actively seek alternatives so that every Nouvie product is a tangible contribution to the care of the environment.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.paragraph1: By 2030, Nouvie will be a leading and recognized brand in the Colombian market for its commitment to health, sustainability and conscious education. We aspire to be a <highlight>benchmark in responsible consumption</highlight>, generating a movement that inspires people to question the ingredients in the products they use and to choose toxic-free alternatives.
vision.paragraph2: Our vision is to build an informed and empowered community that understands the risks associated with harmful chemicals and that, through everyday decisions, actively contributes to the care of the planet. Nouvie will be synonymous with transparency, sustainable innovation and integral well-being.

culture.title: Our Culture
culture.description: At Nouvie, we believe that caring for people is the first step toward caring for the planet. Our organizational culture is founded on deep respect for human health, empathy and collective responsibility.
culture.value1Description: We promote the use of products free of toxic chemicals, understanding that health begins with what we use every day.
culture.value2Description: We work with biodegradable ingredients, clean processes and sustainable packaging.
culture.value3Description: We commit to lasting solutions that respect both people and the environment.
culture.value4Description: We offer accessible alternatives that combine effectiveness, economy and ethics.
culture.teamDescription: Our team is made up of <highlight>honest, empathetic and committed people</highlight> who act with transparency and passion. They are individuals with environmental awareness and human sensitivity, who understand that every action counts and that real change starts from within.

challenge.title: The Challenge
challenge.paragraph1: According to environmental expert studies, the average home contains 62 toxic chemicals in traditional cleaning products.
challenge.paragraph2: Chemicals like ammonia, while they clean, are strong irritants responsible for respiratory, skin, vision and throat diseases. Most of the damage is irreversible.
challenge.paragraph3: There are also 15 toxic chemicals in hair care products: sulfates, parabens and formaldehyde that weaken hair growth and accelerate hair loss.

solution.title: Our Solution
solution.paragraph1: We offer a comprehensive solution through a portfolio of products certified as biodegradable in less than 48 hours, free of sulfates and toxic substances.
solution.paragraph2: Imagine elevating the cleanliness levels of your home with ingredients that eliminate impurities, but without the negative effects of toxic products.
solution.paragraph3: You can enjoy healthier and more vibrant hair without the chemicals that weaken it over the medium and long term.

institucional.aboutDescription: NOUVIE SAS, a company committed to caring for the health of our clients and the environment. We create biodegradable, non-toxic, non-caustic, non-flammable products. NOUVIE offers an integral cleaning system that cleans any type of surface, even the most delicate, without deterioration.
institucional.aboutBenefits: Our products are surfactant-based and help our clients save time and water, as they don't need rinsing since they don't produce excess foam and leave no product traces on surfaces. They are highly efficient yet gentle on your hands, requiring no gloves for use. They extend the useful life of cleaning utensils and most importantly, protect the health of your employees.
institucional.performanceDescription: Thanks to its concentrated formulation with high cleaning power and prolonged protection capacity, our product line allows us to offer better performance within your integral cleaning service, achieving an estimated cost optimization of around 20% to 25% per m2 compared to conventional cleaning products and services.
institucional.sustainabilityDescription: NOUVIE is committed to sustainability and caring for the health of occupants and stakeholders of every asset that uses our products, which is why our cleaning products are aligned with the most recognized international standards.
